active_b1_3_v2_evidence_path: UNCHANGED (spoken-only; freeze-ready; not touched by this ablation)
decision_by_operator: pre-registered ablation chosen over modifying B1.3 (keeps v2 evidence path intact)
motivation: Objection: spoken-only routing ignores word-INITIAL silent consonants. Operator rule under test: a word-initial silent consonant routes to its varṇa's LIBERATING pole. Ad hoc validation (initial-silent-liberating) conformed on ~1/22 words and inverted on 5 -> LOW prior. This pre-registers a fair, uniform test with the same controls, so a null is believable and a positive is not cherry-picked.
honest_scope_caveat: The word-initial-silent-consonant set is mostly NON-object words (know, write, honest, wrong, ...); only knife/wreath are concrete objects. So this is a GENERAL-WORD modulation ablation, NOT a concrete-object study; the introspection/loaded-word confounds we moved away from partially return. Its evidentiary status is therefore WEAKER than the concrete-object study, and it CANNOT feed the concrete-object evidence path.
word_set: b1_3_orthographic_latent_ablation_candidate_wordlist.json (30 eligible; high_confound flags on religious/ethical/mental/social/valence words; a null-and-drop-confound sensitivity analysis is pre-specified)
hypothesis: Does ANY single fixed orthographic-latent routing rule for word-initial silent consonants make A_real beat the controls AND the semantic baseline better than spoken-only, uniformly across the set?

arms_A_real_variants_one_fixed_rule_each.A_spoken: spoken-only route (reference; the active B1.3 rule)
arms_A_real_variants_one_fixed_rule_each.A_ortho_additive: add the initial silent consonant at its natural read_op pole
arms_A_real_variants_one_fixed_rule_each.A_silent_liberating: add the initial silent consonant at the LIBERATING pole (the operator's focal rule)
arms_A_real_variants_one_fixed_rule_each.A_silent_binding: add the initial silent consonant at the BINDING pole
arms_A_real_variants_one_fixed_rule_each.A_silent_dual_or_weighted: add both poles weakly / attenuated weight (hybrid)

instrument: same blinded LLM-judge config as B1.3 (b1_3_concrete_object_llm_judge_model_config_v2), forced A/B, temp 0.0, cross-family; general-word framing (not object-function) since most words are non-objects
primary_comparison: for each rule-arm: A_rule vs A_spoken (does the rule beat spoken-only?) AND A_rule vs semantic_only_baseline (does it beat ordinary meaning?)
success_condition_focal_rule: A_silent_liberating beats A_spoken, beats semantic_only_baseline, and beats deranged/scrambled/random/neutral, UNIFORMLY across the set, surviving drop-high-confound sensitivity and no single model-family dominance
kill_condition: if NO fixed orthographic rule beats spoken-only AND the semantic baseline across the set, the orthographic-latent rescue is CLOSED and spoken-only stands; per-word wins (e.g. knife only) do NOT count

thresholds.win_rate_rule: Wilson lower CI > 0.50 for A_rule vs A_spoken and vs semantic_only_baseline
thresholds.uniformity: not carried by a single word or single silent-letter class (K/G/W/P/H/M reported separately)
thresholds.drop_high_confound_sensitivity: result must hold after removing religious/ethical/mental/social/valence words

kosha_stratified_variant_note.idea: operator proposal: a four-kosha (annamaya/pranamaya/manomaya/vijnanamaya) model where a varṇa's meaning is layer-dependent (e.g. ka = 'cutting' for physical-kosha words, 'detachment' for mental-kosha words)
kosha_stratified_variant_note.status: NOT included in this ablation; NOT implemented
hard_blockers: the frozen lexicon has NO kosha-stratified glosses; ka = hope/āśā only; there is NO 'cutting' reading of ka in the source -> using 'cutting' would be INVENTING a gloss to fit knife (fabrication / lexicon change)

4 koshas x 2 poles = up to 8 readings per varṇa -> massive free-parameter explosion; unfalsifiable unless (a) each word's kosha is assigned by an INDEPENDENT rule not chosen to fit, and (b) the full kosha x varṇa x pole table is fixed and pre-registered BEFORE any run
the motivation is output-first (we want knife=cutting, so posit a physical-kosha layer that yields cutting)
kosha_stratified_variant_note.only_legitimate_path: specify a COMPLETE, independent kosha lexicon (all varṇas x all koshas) with an independent per-word kosha-assignment rule, pre-registered, then test against the same controls -> its own separate gate, never a knife-rescue
